newsitem.title: ITALY: Iveco has no comment on UK plant closure.
newsitem.headline: Iveco has no comment on UK plant closure.

text.p: Italian truck manufacturer Iveco, part of the Fiat industrial group, declined to comment on a newspaper report that its truck assembly plant in Britain at Langley, west of London, was set for closure.
An Iveco spokesman said the group was conducting a strategic review of its production capacity in Europe, and added that it will only make a decision after this review has taken place.

The Financial Times newspaper said that Iveco will announce next month the closure of the Langley plant with the loss of around 500 jobs. In 1986, U.S. automotive group Ford Motor Co sold its UK truck operation based at the Langley plant to Iveco in return for 48 percent of a joint venture Iveco-Ford, to manufacture and sell trucks in the UK.
